findings.text: follow-on: the evidence fragment's Evidence section names the head arm as 'revision f91fa54eeb plus the working tree', but the head-arm receipt it cites, logs/comparison-head.log, opens 'revision: b68b72c556733eb6bbabc17ddc589aa1e2ad052a' and the manifest's after_suite names b68b72c55, so a reader comparing the fragment to the log it cites sees two different head revisions; the measured numbers agree (14 passed) and only the stated revision is wrong.

item_verdicts.diff: read b68b72c55 (and its parent 84f434af0) against base f91fa54eeb; reckon/crew/dispatch.py +209/-6 replaces the supervisor's blocking os.waitpid with _reap_worker_on_its_terminal_manifest and adds _worker_manifest_done_status, _supervisor_manifest_baseline_ns, _supervisor_manifest_path, _terminal_manifest_grace_seconds; tests/test_a_terminal_worker_exits_within_its_grace.py +484; the evidence fragment +105; no other file changes across either commit.
item_verdicts.done_when: the dispatch's FENCE-EVIDENCE names tests/test_a_terminal_worker_exits_within_its_grace.py, a stub worker that writes a complete manifest and sleeps, an exit within the grace measured from the manifest's terminal write, blocked and in-progress cases keeping the worker running, and a logged negative control; the worker's gate.log records 5 passed EXIT=0 and I reproduced 5 passed EXIT=0 in the reviewed worktree (gate-reproduce.log), and the declared grace-exit mutation reproduced red here (2 failed 3 passed EXIT=1, negative-control-reproduce.log).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a worker whose manifest turns terminal exits within a bounded grace without waiting for promotion; _run_supervisor (dispatch.py:8694) now collects the exit through _reap_worker_on_its_terminal_manifest, which ends the worker once its manifest reads complete or failed, so the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, naming the grace env, the done set (complete+failed, blocked kept for resume), the baseline gate, the poll interval, the sender-record-first signal and the SIGKILL escalation, with machine-readable baseline_suite and after_suite JSON; both arm logs open with 'revision:' so their recorded revisions resolve.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are reckon/crew/dispatch.py, tests/test_a_terminal_worker_exits_within_its_grace.py and the evidence fragment; git show --stat over 84f434af0 and b68b72c55 touches exactly those three files and nothing else.

justifications.durability: the declared grace-exit mutation removes the reap and test_a_complete_manifest_ends_the_worker_within_the_grace reddens on the worker staying alive past its grace (negative-control.log, and reproduced here: 2 failed 3 passed EXIT=1), so the guard is verified by reinstating the regression; the second declared mutation drops the baseline comparison and test_a_manifest_left_by_a_previous_attempt_is_not_this_attempts_delivery reddens (negative-control-baseline.log, 1 failed 4 passed EXIT=1).
justifications.evidence: the gate tests/test_a_terminal_worker_exits_within_its_grace.py asserts the done_when measure and I reproduced 5 passed EXIT=0 (gate-reproduce.log); the arm logs comparison-base.log and comparison-head.log record 14 passed each at f91fa54eeb and b68b72c55 so the added-failure count is zero; the arms carry no newly added failures and the fragment's stated head revision diverges from the log it cites.
justifications.fit: the new helpers sit beside _run_supervisor in dispatch.py:8417-8612 and reuse the existing routing.signal_worker (sender record written before the signal) rather than a new os.kill; the done-set comment states why blocked is excluded; no added name carries a plan, sprint or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: dispatch.py:8694 routes the supervisor's exit collection through _reap_worker_on_its_terminal_manifest, which ends a worker whose manifest is complete or failed within a grace (RECKON_WORKER_TERMINAL_GRACE_SECONDS, default 300 s) measured from the manifest's own write time, escalating SIGTERM to SIGKILL after 10 s; blocked is excluded and kept for resume and in-progress is waited on, both as the done-when requires.
